map.多余功率决定爬升率。: Excess power determines the rate of climb.
map.多余功率越大爬升越快。: The greater the excess power, the faster the climb.
map.性能核算中，由可用功率 Pa 与所需功率 Ps 之差、重量 W，算爬升率 ROC: In performance accounting, compute the rate of climb ROC=(Pa−Ps)/W from the difference between available power Pa and required power Ps and the weight W.
map.判断飞机能否在限定的越障梯度上爬升，用于起飞越障评估。: Judge whether an aircraft can climb on a specified obstacle-clearance gradient, used for takeoff obstacle assessment.
map.对比不同高度（功率随高度衰减）的爬升率，找最佳爬升速度。: Compare the rate of climb at different altitudes (power falls with altitude) to find the best climb speed.
map.可用功率盈余的爬升率: Rate of climb from the available-power surplus
map.可用功率 Pa=2000 kW、所需功率 Ps=1800 kW、重量 W=600: Available power Pa=2000 kW, required power Ps=1800 kW and weight W=600000 N. Power surplus=200000 W, ROC = 200000/600000 = 0.333 m/s = 1200 m/h. That is, it rises about 0.33 metres per second.
map.爬升率单位常看到 ft/min 怎么换算？: How do I convert the ft/min commonly seen for rate of climb?
1 m/s = 196.85 ft/min. In the example above 0.333 m/s ≈ 65.6 ft/min (an illustrative low value; a real transport is about 1000-2500 ft/min). Note that Pa and Ps use the same unit (watts) and W uses newtons, so the result is in m/s.
map.为什么高空爬升率会下降？: Why does the rate of climb fall at high altitude?
map.发动机功率/推力随空气密度下降而降低，所需功率随真速上升，可用盈余被压缩，故爬升: Engine power/thrust drops as air density falls while the required power rises with the true speed, so the available surplus is squeezed; the rate of climb therefore first rises then falls with altitude, giving a theoretical absolute ceiling.
